contract: The Python and TypeScript SDKs expose calculated NOI snapshots as read-only list, detail, and crop-cycle-filtered data.
findings: noi_snapshot stores calculated financial outputs and their calculation version, timestamp, and source inputs.
The location-scoped signed snapshot worker reconciles eligible rows from v_crop_cycle_noi.
No repository callsite uses SDK noi.create/createMany/update/delete methods.
Generic SDK writes permit callers to supply calculated outputs and provenance fields without running the snapshot calculation.
change: Removed GenericMethods mutation inheritance and create/createMany/update/delete from both NoiMethods surfaces. Preserved list/get/listByCropCycle with authoritative crop-cycle filter merging. Documented the service/worker boundary.
scope_limits: SDK calls were mocked; no database, provider, candidate, or legacy service was used.
Existing CLI, signed-worker, and Directus-extension snapshot writers were not changed or runtime-validated in this slice.
This does not establish universal tenant isolation or change capability/MAN-CAP acceptance.
rollback: Restore SDK mutation methods only after all write paths enforce calculated snapshot provenance, location scope, and explicit reconciliation semantics.
